lessons.title: Introduction to Plotting with Pandas 📊
lessons.description: Learn to use the plot() method, create line and bar plots, and understand the basics of pandas visualization.

lessons.title: Line and Area Plots 📈
lessons.description: Dive deep into line plots – multiple series, styling, markers, and area plots.

lessons.title: Bar Charts and Histograms 📊
lessons.description: Create vertical and horizontal bar charts, stacked bars, and histograms to show distributions.

lessons.title: Scatter and Box Plots 🎯
lessons.description: Visualize relationships with scatter plots, box plots, and other statistical charts.

lessons.title: Customizing and Saving Plots 🎨
lessons.description: Add labels, titles, legends, change figure size, styles, and export your visualizations.
